name: Nordmende CDEC62IX — 60cm Freestanding Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Nordmende CDEC62IX is a 60cm freestanding electric cooker in stainless steel with twin cavities — a 63L main fan oven and a 36L top oven with grill — over a four-zone ceramic hob. Residual-heat indicators, child lock and a timer add convenience, and an easy-clean enamel interior keeps upkeep low. A energy rated, 3-year warranty on registration.
features: Twin cavity — 63L main fan + 36L top with grill
